inputs.text:
Open your eyes, people. They want you to believe this is just standard diplomacy, but it is all a smokescreen for the real control grid being built from the shadows. Look at what they are actually admitting to right out in the open. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris, formalizing a partnership to design the country’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, all witnessed by President Luis Abinader while he continued his high-level agenda in France this week. 

"Transparency" and "global standards" are just coded language for total centralized surveillance and compliance with unelected international technocrats. They are forcing the Dominican Republic’s integration into their hidden architecture of control, masquerading as anti-corruption efforts while the real elites pull the strings from behind closed doors in Paris. Do not fall for the official narrative—this MoU is about locking the nation down under foreign oversight.
